kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_reads_completed_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_writes_completed_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_disk_reads_completed_total_A = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_reads_completed_total)), Writes_completed = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_writes_completed_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL Reads_completed = (-1 * node_disk_reads_completed_total_A)
| DROP node_disk_reads_completed_total_A
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_read_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_written_bytes_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_disk_read_bytes_total_A = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_read_bytes_total)), Written_bytes = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_written_bytes_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL Read_bytes = (-1 * node_disk_read_bytes_total_A)
| DROP node_disk_read_bytes_total_A
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_read_time_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_reads_completed_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_write_time_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_writes_completed_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_disk_read_time_seconds_total_A_lhs = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_read_time_seconds_total)), node_disk_reads_completed_total_A_rhs = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_reads_completed_total)), node_disk_write_time_seconds_total_B_lhs = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_write_time_seconds_total)), node_disk_writes_completed_total_B_rhs = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_writes_completed_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL Read_wait_time_avg = (-1 * (node_disk_read_time_seconds_total_A_lhs / node_disk_reads_completed_total_A_rhs))
| EVAL Write_wait_time_avg = (node_disk_write_time_seconds_total_B_lhs / node_disk_writes_completed_total_B_rhs)
| DROP node_disk_read_time_seconds_total_A_lhs, node_disk_reads_completed_total_A_rhs, node_disk_write_time_seconds_total_B_lhs, node_disk_writes_completed_total_B_rhs
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS value = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL series_group = COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.device`), "")
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_reads_merged_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_writes_merged_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_disk_reads_merged_total_A = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_reads_merged_total)), Write_merged = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_writes_merged_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL Read_merged = (-1 * node_disk_reads_merged_total_A)
| DROP node_disk_reads_merged_total_A
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_io_time_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_discard_time_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS IO = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_io_time_seconds_total)), discard = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_discard_time_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.device`, IO, discard
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_io_now IS NOT NULL
| STATS value = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_disk_io_now)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL series_group = COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.device`), "")
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_discards_completed_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_discards_merged_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS Discards_completed = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_discards_completed_total)), Discards_merged = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_disk_discards_merged_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.device`, Discards_completed, Discards_merged
| SORT time_bucket ASC
